checks.quote: # Proposed Reproducible Bulk RNA-seq Differential-Expression Analysis Plan

checks.quote: Donor confounded with condition or batch.
checks.reason: The unconditional non-identifiability branch rejects ordinary between-donor treatment allocation, which can be estimable with donors as replicates and no saturated donor indicators. The design needs that valid branch; the primary Wald/LRT test is also not explicitly selected.

checks.quote: sensitivity re-run at a second threshold
checks.reason: No bounded preprocessing/filter/model exploration, objective evaluation rule and lock is specified; an unspecified second significance threshold does not supply the required operational sensitivity plan.

checks.quote: # Proposed Reproducible Bulk RNA-seq Differential-Expression Analysis Plan

checks.quote: report as underpowered
checks.reason: No significant genes does not establish inadequate power; a small true effect or absent effect is also possible. Report uncertainty/detectable effects and reserve absence claims for adequate precision.

checks.quote: # Proposed Reproducible Bulk RNA-seq Differential-Expression Analysis Plan
